name: Friction Loss Calculator
description: Calculate friction head loss in pipes per 100m using Hazen-Williams C-factor for water systems.

seo.title: Friction Loss Calculator - Pipe Head Loss
seo.description: Calculate pipe friction head loss using Hazen-Williams formula for water distribution systems.

formula.explanation: Hazen-Williams (SI): hf = 10.67 × Q^1.852 / (C^1.852 × D^4.8704) × L. Q in m³/s, D in m, L in m; result in meters of water head loss.

inputs.label: Hazen-Williams C-Factor
inputs.hint: New steel: 120, PVC: 150, Old cast iron: 80-100

content.introduction: Calculate friction head loss in water pipes using the Hazen-Williams formula, commonly used in water distribution and fire sprinkler system design. C-factors: new steel=120, PVC/HDPE=150, copper=140, old cast iron=80-100.

example.description: 50 m³/h through 100mm C=120 steel pipe: ~4m head loss per 100m.

faq.a: New steel pipe: 120; PVC/HDPE: 150; copper: 140; 20-year-old steel: 100; old cast iron: 80. Conservative design uses lower values.
Only for water at 40-75°F (5-25°C) in turbulent flow. Use Darcy-Weisbach for other fluids or higher accuracy.
